messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for HelixCorp (dedicated-helix-01). Service: reserved-pool/helix-01. Symptom: p95 tail latency > 2s, 5xx spike (~12% of requests). PD INC-8241. Dash: https://dash.redwood/helix-01/latency, runbook: /runbooks/dedicated-io-throttle

sam_sre: acked on PD. I'm looking at the dashboard now. p50 ok, p95 and p99 skyrocket. no obvious model cpu spike, looks like IO wait on a subset of nodes.

anya_prod: seeing a lot of nvme and fs errors in node logs, e.g.:
```
[2026-03-14T18:02:12Z] kernel: nvme0: I/O 0x3a7 timeout, status: 0x1
[2026-03-14T18:02:12Z] inference-daemon: kvcache: write failed, err=EIO
```
Queue depth for tenant helix-01 increased from 12 -> 180 over 5m. Prefetch eviction started.

darren_infra: confirmed. iostat shows 98% utilization on /dev/nvme1n1 on 3/6 GPU nodes in the pool. Autoscaler attempted to spin new nodes but instance creation failing with ENOSPC on block volume attach. Cloud account limit looks hit for gp3 volumes.

maria_oncall: tagging cloud infra -- @darren_infra can you confirm quota error? If quota hit, we should failover traffic to helix-fallback cluster and notify Helix account lead. Also capturing customer impact: internal metric shows ~12% error rate for web-inference route, mostly EU region tenants.

pd-bot: PDINC INC-8241 acknowledged by sam_sre at 18:04 UTC. Escalation policy: oncall -> infra-lead after 10m if not resolved.

sam_sre: quick mitigation plan: 1) move non-critical traffic to fallback cluster, 2) reduce KV cache size for helix-01 to drop disk writes, 3) try node drain + restart io-daemon on affected nodes. I'll start (1) now.

ops-bot: Routing change applied: traffic for route helix:api -> helix-fallback-02 (50% drain) via infractl. Command: `infractl route update --tenant helix --from dedicated-helix-01 --to helix-fallback-02 --weight 50`

anya_prod: running node-level fix: restarted nvme driver on node-helix-03 and restarted inference runtime. Logs show IO errors reduce immediately on that host. p95 for that host dropped from 2.4s -> 320ms.

darren_infra: cloud console shows we hit gp3 volume count limit (account quota). I've opened a quota increase ticket but ETA unknown. For immediate action I can detach some non-prod volumes and reattach, but that's invasive. Suggest keep routing drain and continue restart+evict strategy.

maria_oncall: agreed. Notifying Helix support: @helix-cs (external) -- short note: "We detected elevated errors on your dedicated cluster helix-01 due to transient storage I/O saturation. We've started routing a portion of traffic to fallback and performing node restarts. Expect partial recovery within 15-30m. We'll follow up with full post-incident summary."

sam_sre: monitoring. Dashboard: p95 cluster now 1.1s (was 2.7s). Error rate down to ~4%. Continuing restarts on remaining bad nodes, and lowering kvcache size for helix-01 to reduce disk pressure. Command used: `redwoodctl tenant config set helix --kv-cache-size 256MB`

anya_prod: confirming kvcache change applied. Also flipping fallback policy to 70% traffic to helix-fallback-02 while we stabilize.

pd-bot: INC-8241 escalated to infra-lead (darren_infra) at 18:16 UTC due to >10m active PD ack window.

darren_infra: I'm on-call for escalation. Will coordinate volume detach plan if restarts don't hold. Also running a quick scrub script to identify any candidate non-prod volumes to drop.

maria_oncall: customer impact summary for execs (for notification):
- affected tenant: HelixCorp (dedicated-helix-01)
- incident start: 2026-03-14T18:02 UTC
- symptom: storage I/O saturation causing p95 >2s and 5xx spike (~12% peak)
- mitigation: partial traffic failover to helix-fallback-02, node restarts, kvcache size reduction
- current status: degraded -> improving (errors ~4%, p95 ~1.1s)
- next steps: continue stabilization, monitor quota ticket, postmortem if >1h or customer impact >5% for >30m

sam_sre: will keep PD INC-8241 open until all nodes stable and we revert routing. If recovery holds, plan for handoff to night team at 22:00 UTC. Adding runbook notes and commands used to the PD incident.

ops-bot: PM to helix account exec queued. `pager notify --to helix-exec@helixcorp.com --body "We routed traffic and performing node restarts; partial recovery observed."`

anya_prod: brief post-fix checks: ran synthetic requests against helix-01 traffic path, 99/100 responses within SLA on the repaired nodes.

sam_sre: :white_check_mark: marking this thread as active mitigation. Will post final update before handoff or close if stable for 30m.

maria_oncall: handing off to night oncall at 22:00 UTC: next oncall is darren_infra. Include PD INC-8241 link and `infractl` audit log.

darren_infra: acknowledged takeover for 22:00. I'll continue to monitor quotas and prepare detach plan if needed.

incident-bot: Note: This thread was automatically created by PagerDuty integration. Use the incident runbook for checklist and add any further detections to INC-8241. :memo:
